text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my. So you could use magic, Chan-Me? 
This is the first I've heard of it. Truly 
a shock-ing rev-e-la-tion.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Don't play dumb! You were just talking to 
a cat a second ago! Is that cat your 
familiar or something?!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A cat... Do you mean Hattori Shinobimaru? 
I can't believe our rendezvous was 
witnessed. However, he and I are merely 
friends.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"You're not a familiar, but you can 
understand our speech... Does that mean 
you can use animal communication magic?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Lately, Chan-Me has been expanding her 
circle of friends, and now I'm on chatting 
terms with Mr. Post-chan, the round red 
postbox. Ahem.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'll introduce you to Sweep next time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Even inanimate objects?! You can talk to 
spirits too?! And without any spells or 
magical tools... You really do have the 
makings of a witch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't mind making you an apprentice 
to the genius magical girl, Sweepy, as a 
special treat!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"A magical girl's apprentice... Magical 
Mascot Ma-chan... Shortened to 'Mama 
Ma-chan'—I like the sound of that."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Though I may be inexperienced, Chan-chan 
is in your care, Master.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the Reigi is ringing, isn't it?♪ Then 
hurry up and take me to the Spirit of the 
Mailbox!
